paragraphs.text: Rebuke not an elder, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brethren:
paragraphs.original: Πρεσβυτέρῳ μὴ ἐπιπλήξῃς, ἀλλὰ παρακάλει ὡς πατέρα, νεωτέρους ὡς ἀδελφούς,
paragraphs.translit: Presbyterō mē epiplēxēs, alla parakalei hōs patera, neōterous hōs adelphous,

paragraphs.text: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
paragraphs.original: πρεσβυτέρας ὡς μητέρας, νεωτέρας ὡς ἀδελφὰς ἐν πάσῃ ἁγνείᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: presbyteras hōs mēteras, neōteras hōs adelphas en pasē hagneia.

paragraphs.text: Honor widows that are widows indeed.
paragraphs.original: Χήρας τίμα τὰς ὄντως χήρας.
paragraphs.translit: Chēras tima tas ontōs chēras.

paragraphs.text: But if any widow hath children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety towards their own family, and to requite their parents: for this is acceptable in the sight of God.
paragraphs.original: εἰ δέ τις χήρα τέκνα ἢ ἔκγονα ἔχει, μανθανέτωσαν πρῶτον τὸν ἴδιον οἶκον εὐσεβεῖν καὶ ἀμοιβὰς ἀποδιδόναι τοῖς προγόνοις, τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ei de tis chēra tekna ē ekgona echei, manthanetōsan prōton ton idion oikon eusebein kai amoibas apodidonai tois progonois, touto gar estin apodekton enōpion tou theou.

paragraphs.text: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, hath her hope set on God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
paragraphs.original: ἡ δὲ ὄντως χήρα καὶ μεμονωμένη ἤλπικεν ἐπὶ θεὸν καὶ προσμένει ταῖς δεήσεσιν καὶ ταῖς προσευχαῖς νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας·
paragraphs.translit: hē de ontōs chēra kai memonōmenē ēlpiken epi theon kai prosmenei tais deēsesin kai tais proseuchais nyktos kai hēmeras·

paragraphs.text: But she that giveth herself to pleasure is dead while she liveth.
paragraphs.original: ἡ δὲ σπαταλῶσα ζῶσα τέθνηκεν.
paragraphs.translit: hē de spatalōsa zōsa tethnēken.

paragraphs.text: These things also command, that they may be without reproach.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ταῦτα παράγγελλε, ἵνα ἀνεπίλημπτοι ὦσιν·
paragraphs.translit: kai tauta parangelle, hina anepilēmptoi ōsin·

paragraphs.text: But if any provideth not for his own, and specially his own household, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an unbeliever.
paragraphs.original: εἰ δέ τις τῶν ἰδίων καὶ μάλιστα οἰκείων οὐ προνοεῖ, τὴν πίστιν ἤρνηται καὶ ἔστιν ἀπίστου χείρων.
paragraphs.translit: ei de tis tōn idiōn kai malista oikeiōn ou pronoei, tēn pistin ērnētai kai estin apistou cheirōn.

paragraphs.text: Let none be enrolled as a widow under threescore years old, [having been] the wife of one man,
paragraphs.original: Χήρα καταλεγέσθω μὴ ἔλαττον ἐτῶν ἑξήκοντα γεγονυῖα, ἑνὸς ἀνδρὸς γυνή,
paragraphs.translit: Chēra katalegesthō mē elatton etōn hexēkonta gegonyia, henos andros gynē,

paragraphs.text: well reported of for good works; if she hath brought up children, if she hath used hospitality to strangers, if she hath washed the saints` feet, if she hath relieved the afflicted, if she hath diligently followed every good work.
paragraphs.original: ἐν ἔργοις καλοῖς μαρτυρουμένη, εἰ ἐτεκνοτρόφησεν, εἰ ἐξενοδόχησεν, εἰ ἁγίων πόδας ἔνιψεν, εἰ θλιβομένοις ἐπήρκεσεν, εἰ παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ ἐπηκολούθησεν.
paragraphs.translit: en ergois kalois martyroumenē, ei eteknotrophēsen, ei exenodochēsen, ei hagiōn podas enipsen, ei thlibomenois epērkesen, ei panti ergō agathō epēkolouthēsen.

paragraphs.text: But younger widows refuse: for when they have waxed wanton against Christ, they desire to marry;
paragraphs.original: νεωτέρας δὲ χήρας παραιτοῦ· ὅταν γὰρ καταστρηνιάσωσιν τοῦ Χριστοῦ, γαμεῖν θέλουσιν,
paragraphs.translit: neōteras de chēras paraitou· hotan gar katastrēniasōsin tou Christou, gamein thelousin,

paragraphs.text: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
paragraphs.original: ἔχουσαι κρίμα ὅτι τὴν πρώτην πίστιν ἠθέτησαν·
paragraphs.translit: echousai krima hoti tēn prōtēn pistin ēthetēsan·

paragraphs.text: And withal they learn also [to be] idle, going about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
paragraphs.original: ἅμα δὲ καὶ ἀργαὶ μανθάνουσιν, περιερχόμεναι τὰς οἰκίας, οὐ μόνον δὲ ἀργαὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ φλύαροι καὶ περίεργοι, λαλοῦσαι τὰ μὴ δέοντα.
paragraphs.translit: hama de kai argai manthanousin, perierchomenai tas oikias, ou monon de argai alla kai phlyaroi kai periergoi, lalousai ta mē deonta.

paragraphs.text: I desire therefore that the younger [widows] marry, bear children, rule the household, give no occasion to the adversary for reviling:
paragraphs.original: βούλομαι οὖν νεωτέρας γαμεῖν, τεκνογονεῖν, οἰκοδεσποτεῖν, μηδεμίαν ἀφορμὴν διδόναι τῷ ἀντικειμένῳ λοιδορίας χάριν·
paragraphs.translit: boulomai oun neōteras gamein, teknogonein, oikodespotein, mēdemian aphormēn didonai tō antikeimenō loidorias charin·

paragraphs.text: for already some are turned aside after Satan.
paragraphs.original: ἤδη γάρ τινες ἐξετράπησαν ὀπίσω τοῦ Σατανᾶ.
paragraphs.translit: ēdē gar tines exetrapēsan opisō tou Satana.

paragraphs.text: If any woman that believeth hath widows, let her relieve them, and let not the church be burdened; that it mat relieve them that are widows indeed.
paragraphs.original: εἴ τις πιστὴ ἔχει χήρας, ἐπαρκείτω αὐταῖς, καὶ μὴ βαρείσθω ἡ ἐκκλησία, ἵνα ταῖς ὄντως χήραις ἐπαρκέσῃ.
paragraphs.translit: ei tis pistē echei chēras, eparkeitō autais, kai mē bareisthō hē ekklēsia, hina tais ontōs chērais eparkesē.

paragraphs.text: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
paragraphs.original: Οἱ καλῶς προεστῶτες πρεσβύτεροι διπλῆς τιμῆς ἀξιούσθωσαν, μάλιστα οἱ κοπιῶντες ἐν λόγῳ καὶ διδασκαλίᾳ·
paragraphs.translit: Hoi kalōs proestōtes presbyteroi diplēs timēs axiousthōsan, malista hoi kopiōntes en logō kai didaskalia·

paragraphs.text: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn. And, The laborer is worthy of his hire.
paragraphs.original: λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφή· Βοῦν ἀλοῶντα οὐ φιμώσεις, καί· Ἄξιος ὁ ἐργάτης τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: legei gar hē graphē· Boun aloōnta ou phimōseis, kai· Axios ho ergatēs tou misthou autou.

paragraphs.text: Against an elder receive not an accusation, except at [the mouth of] two or three witnesses.
paragraphs.original: κατὰ πρεσβυτέρου κατηγορίαν μὴ παραδέχου, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ ἐπὶ δύο ἢ τριῶν μαρτύρων·
paragraphs.translit: kata presbyterou katēgorian mē paradechou, ektos ei mē epi dyo ē triōn martyrōn·

paragraphs.text: Them that sin reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
paragraphs.original: τοὺς ἁμαρτάνοντας ἐνώπιον πάντων ἔλεγχε, ἵνα καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ φόβον ἔχωσιν.
paragraphs.translit: tous hamartanontas enōpion pantōn elenche, hina kai hoi loipoi phobon echōsin.

paragraphs.text: I charge [thee] in the sight of God, and Christ Jesus, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.
paragraphs.original: διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν ἀγγέλων, ἵνα ταῦτα φυλάξῃς χωρὶς προκρίματος, μηδὲν ποιῶν κατὰ πρόσκλισιν.
paragraphs.translit: diamartyromai enōpion tou theou kai Christou Iēsou kai tōn eklektōn angelōn, hina tauta phylaxēs chōris prokrimatos, mēden poiōn kata prosklisin.

paragraphs.text: Lay hands hastily on no man, neither be partaker of other men`s sins: keep thyself pure.
paragraphs.original: χεῖρας ταχέως μηδενὶ ἐπιτίθει, μηδὲ κοινώνει ἁμαρτίαις ἀλλοτρίαις· σεαυτὸν ἁγνὸν τήρει.
paragraphs.translit: cheiras tacheōs mēdeni epitithei, mēde koinōnei hamartiais allotriais· seauton hagnon tērei.

paragraphs.text: Be no longer a drinker of water, but use a little wine for thy stomach`s sake and thine often infirmities.
paragraphs.original: μηκέτι ὑδροπότει, ἀλλὰ οἴνῳ ὀλίγῳ χρῶ διὰ τὸν στόμαχον καὶ τὰς πυκνάς σου ἀσθενείας.
paragraphs.translit: mēketi hydropotei, alla oinō oligō chrō dia ton stomachon kai tas pyknas sou astheneias.

paragraphs.text: Some men`s sins are evident, going before unto judgment; and some men also they follow after.
paragraphs.original: Τινῶν ἀνθρώπων αἱ ἁμαρτίαι πρόδηλοί εἰσιν, προάγουσαι εἰς κρίσιν, τισὶν δὲ καὶ ἐπακολουθοῦσιν·
paragraphs.translit: Tinōn anthrōpōn hai hamartiai prodēloi eisin, proagousai eis krisin, tisin de kai epakolouthousin·

paragraphs.text: In like manner also there are good works that are evident; and such as are otherwise cannot be hid.
paragraphs.original: ὡσαύτως καὶ τὰ ἔργα τὰ καλὰ πρόδηλα, καὶ τὰ ἄλλως ἔχοντα κρυβῆναι οὐ δύνανται.
paragraphs.translit: hōsautōs kai ta erga ta kala prodēla, kai ta allōs echonta krybēnai ou dynantai.
